useCase: scientific-educational Dino Atlas M0 motion pilot

policy.scope: environment-only ambient motion over a fixed approved still

copyrightSafety.note: Each pilot derives only from its named project-owned generated still and a locally composited abstract environmental layer; no external footage or artwork is used.

workflow.motionRule: Keep the source still fixed. Animate only an isolated breath, ground-mist, or sky-light environmental layer.

yutyrannus-huali-cold-breath-ambient-m0-.motionLayer: localized cold-breath plume near the mouth
yutyrannus-huali-cold-breath-ambient-m0-.prompt: M0 ambient-motion test: preserve every source-still anatomy pixel and composite only a subtle localized cold-breath plume; no body, head, limb, feather, camera, or background deformation.

motionQa.note: Two breath pulses remain left of the muzzle and are visible at mobile width without altering the animal.

motion.note: Localized visibility and fixed-body checks passed; significant change is 99.11% inside the breath zone.

publication.note: File, motion, responsive, accessibility, and provenance gates passed on 2026-08-03.

tyrannosaurus-rex-ground-mist-ambient-m0.prompt: M0 ambient-motion test: preserve every source-still anatomy pixel and composite only low ground mist isolated below the animal; no body, head, limb, camera, or background deformation.

motionQa.note: Mist stays in the right foreground, clear of the head, feet, tail underside, and body silhouette.

motion.note: Ground isolation and fixed-body checks passed; significant change is 99.59% inside the mist zone.

publication.note: File, motion, responsive, accessibility, and provenance gates passed on 2026-08-03.

brachiosaurus-altithorax-skylight-ambien.prompt: M0 ambient-motion test: preserve every source-still anatomy pixel, especially the high shoulders and rounded nasal mound/high nostril cue, and composite only subtle upper-frame sky-light and haze; no body, head, limb, camera, or background deformation.

motionQa.note: Sky-light remains above and right of the neck; the rounded nasal mound, high nostril, and high-shouldered body plan remain untouched.

anatomy.note: High shoulders and nasal mound remain inherited from the fixed poster; not new anatomy evidence.

motion.note: Sky isolation and fixed-body checks passed; significant change is 99.65% inside the sky-light zone.

publication.note: File, motion, responsive, accessibility, and provenance gates passed on 2026-08-03.
